title: AI Provider Credentials
description: API credentials for AI model providers (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.)

API_KEY.title: API Key
API_KEY.description: API key for the AI provider

BASE_URL.title: Base URL
BASE_URL.description: Optional: Custom base URL for the API (e.g., OpenRouter, Azure OpenAI)

PROJECT_ID.title: Project ID
PROJECT_ID.description: Optional: Project ID (for providers like GCP Vertex AI)

REGION.title: Region
REGION.description: Optional: API region (e.g., us-central1 for GCP)

SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.title: Service Account JSON
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Optional: Paste the service account JSON key to authenticate Vertex AI

CLIENT_ID.title: OAuth Client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: Optional: OAuth client ID for building refresh-token credentials

CLIENT_SECRET.title: OAuth Client Secret
CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional: OAuth client secret for building refresh-token credentials

REFRESH_TOKEN.title: Refresh Token
REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Optional: OAuth refresh token to obtain Vertex AI access tokens
